summary: First-finish smoke test for PlateSense (meal-analysis app). Backend and frontend end-to-end flows all working. Backend health, auth, meals (POST/GET/DELETE), goals (GET/PUT), nutrition summary, and Claude Sonnet 5 suggestions all returned expected JSON. Frontend landing, login, dashboard (rings, meal-input, edit-goals, meal-analyze, suggestions-refresh) all functional with authenticated session cookie.
passed: GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token -> user JSON
POST /api/meals -> meal_id 'meal_...', numeric nutrients, summary, healthiness_score, tags (AI call ~5-10s)
Frontend /dashboard with session_token cookie loads with heading 'what's on the plate', nutrition rings (calories/protein/carbs/fat), meal-input, edit-goals-btn
Meal analyze from UI: typed meal + click analyze -> new meal card appears in meal-history, rings updated (259 cal etc.)
Edit goals dialog: changed calories to 2500, save closes dialog, ring denominator updated to /2500
